text:
Jorge: Quick handoff for AtlasSync — signed today. Sales notes: mid-market, onboarding ASAP, using embeddings heavily. They want hosted now, but asked for Private eval for data residency in EU. Major risks: EU latency spikes seen in perf logs, SSO still pending from customer side, projected embedding volume could push them above free tier in month 1.

Maya: Taking lead on CS. Thanks Jorge. Can you drop the contract + perf logs and customer SOC/SSO contact?

Jorge: Posted links: https://drive.redwood/AtlasSync/contract.pdf and https://s3.redwood/perf/atlasync-eu-spikes.log Customer SSO contact: nina@atlasync.com. Primary PO: marc@atlasync.com

Maya: OK — initial plan: 1) Ownership & stakeholders, 2) EU smoke perf test, 3) SSO setup + test, 4) Embed usage forecast + cost mitigation, 5) Private eval kickoff if perf/SSO blocks. Assigning: Maya = CS lead; Priya = Support runbook + on-call for troubleshooting; Liam = Eng for Private perf.

Priya: I can own runbook and triage. Need steps to reproduce latency and any synthetic traffic samples. When do we want the first smoke test?

Maya: Target first smoke test Tue 09:00 UTC (next week). Jorge — can your AE get Nina to approve SSO test window?

Jorge: Will nudge Nina today. Also FYI procurement wants a 12mo pricing discussion — timeline ~6 weeks. Flagging renewal risk if onboarding delayed. :warning:

Liam: For perf I'll need: model name they're using, typical max seq length, expected tokens/sec, and an example corpus. Also share the perf log extract. Example load command I can run locally:

```bash
# k6 simple load sample to hit hosted inference endpoint
K6_SCRIPT='import http from "k6/http"; export default function(){http.post("https://api.redwood/v1/generate", JSON.stringify({model:"open-model-x",input:"test"}), {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $TOKEN','Content-Type':'application/json'}})}'
k6 run --vus 10 --duration 1m - <(echo "$K6_SCRIPT")
```

Liam: If hosts are rate-limiting we can spin test on a dedicated pool; will coordinate with eng-infra.

Maya: I'll upload the customer prompt set and embed workload snapshot to the shared folder. Also adding a short feedback capture: ask AtlasSync for 3 priority success metrics (latency P50/P95, embed cost per 10k, and SSO SAML pass rate).

Priya: I'll create a support ticket and link runbook. Ticket: SUP-9986. Adding checklist items: reproduce spike, confirm regional routing, collect request IDs.

enablement-bot: Shared onboarding runbook: https://wiki.redwood/onboarding/runbooks/enterprise-playbook. Template: "EU smoke test" added.

Maya: Summary of owners & next steps (I'll follow up in #customer-success weekly): - CS lead: Maya -> kickoff + weekly summaries - Support: Priya -> SUP-9986, runbook + triage - Eng: Liam -> perf tests + Private eval sizing - Sales: Jorge -> confirm SSO window + procurement timeline

Maya: Immediate next actions (this week): 1) Jorge get Nina to approve SSO test window (due EOD Fri). 2) Priya to open SUP-9986 with logs + reproducer (in 24h). 3) Liam to review perf log and confirm data needed (48h). 4) I will run a quick cost forecast and share mitigations (72h).

Jorge: Noted. I'll escalate procurement timeline to AE team.

Liam: I'll start with the log extract and reply in thread with questions. Expect update in ~36h.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll publish a kickoff note in channel after we have Nina's SSO window. Raising renewal/watch flag in account record until onboarding hits the first milestone.

Priya: Added a comment in SUP-9986 with the perf log link.

Maya: Closing loop: weekly sync cadence Wednesday 14:00 UTC, and I’ll post notes. If anything blocks earlier, ping here and @Priya or @Liam.

Jorge: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
